DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with Dementia (PDD)

The asymmetric progression of your tremor starting in one hand, combined with executive memory deficits like bill payment issues and difficulties with fine motor tasks, strongly suggests a neurodegenerative process affecting both the basal ganglia and cortical regions. While your MRI results will help rule out structural causes like strokes or tumors, the clinical picture of a resting tremor that worsens over time alongside cognitive decline is characteristic of Parkinson's disease progressing to dementia. Do you have a family history of similar movement disorders, and are you currently experiencing any freezing of movement or shuffling gait?
